title: Taxi fare and baggage charge increases
summary: On August 4, the committee approved Bill 101 as amended and moved it to pass first reading. The bill would raise the general taxicab baggage charge from 50 cents to $1 per piece per trip, and allow a $10 charge for large items like surfboards. An amendment made oversized baggage mean 50 pounds or more.

timeline.text: A member moved to count bags of 50 pounds or more as oversized.
